scope: Only 21 new Listening and 6 new Speaking sample masters; original 3 legacy WAVs and all ASR fixtures excluded. All 27 WAV masters preserved in place.

engine.ffmpegVersion: ffmpeg version 9.0.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
engine.gainPurpose: Constant headroom prevents lossy-codec reconstruction overshoot; WAV masters remain unchanged.
engine.metadataPolicy: Drop inherited metadata; retain only the stable encoder tag written by FFmpeg. No timestamps, filenames, transcripts or user metadata are embedded.

androidSupport.documentedDecoder: Opus supported from Android 5.0; Ogg is a listed container.
androidSupport.assessment: The documented platform requirement is met for this app. Actual MediaPlayer device playback remains a separate integration check.

timelinePolicy.description: Opus granule positions and pre-skip use a 48kHz clock. Playable duration is (final granule − pre-skip)/48000. FFprobe container duration includes pre-skip and is not the comparison duration. Every derivative is fully decoded at 48kHz and again at the master sample rate. Resampling may add one source-rate frame; no negative frame delta, trim, pad, or seek is used in validation.
timelinePolicy.transcriptSegments: Original millisecond transcript boundaries remain valid; at most one source-rate frame is added, which can increase the rounded total duration by 1 millisecond at a rounding boundary.
